name: wrike
label: Wrike
description: Create and update tasks, folders, projects and comments in Wrike, and start tasks when tasks, folders or subtasks are created.

create_task.label: Create Task
create_task.description: Create a new task in Wrike

folderId.label: Folder ID
folderId.description: The ID of the folder where the task will be created

assignees.label: Assignees
assignees.description: User IDs to assign to the task. A JSON list such as [{"userId": "KUAAAAAA"}].

customFields.label: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Custom field values for the task. A JSON list such as [{"fieldId": "IEAAAAAA", "value": "42"}].

create_task.beforeRequest:
const has=v=>v!=null&&String(v).trim()!=='';const list=v=>{if(!has(v))return[];const a=typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):v;return Array.isArray(a)?a:[a]};const ids=(v,k)=>list(v).map(x=>x&&typeof x==='object'?x[k]:x).filter(has).map(String);const seg=v=>encodeURIComponent(String(v).trim());const day=v=>String(v).split('T')[0];
const b={title:inputs.title};if(has(inputs.description))b.description=inputs.description;if(has(inputs.status))b.status=inputs.status;if(has(inputs.importance))b.importance=inputs.importance;const r=ids(inputs.assignees,'userId');if(r.length)b.responsibles=r;const d={};if(has(inputs.start_date))d.start=inputs.start_date;if(has(inputs.due_date))d.due=inputs.due_date;if(has(inputs.duration)&&Number(inputs.duration))d.duration=Number(inputs.duration);if(Object.keys(d).length)b.dates=d;const cf=list(inputs.customFields).map(x=>({id:x.fieldId,value:x.value}));if(cf.length)b.customFields=cf;request.url='/folders/'+seg(inputs.folderId)+'/tasks';request.body=b;return request;

update_task.label: Update Task
update_task.description: Update fields of an existing task in Wrike

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: The ID of the task to update

title.label: Task Title
title.description: The new title of the task

description.label: Description
description.description: The new description of the task

status.label: Status
status.description: The new status of the task

importance.label: Importance
importance.description: The new importance/priority of the task

assignees.label: Assignees
assignees.description: User IDs to assign to the task (replaces existing assignees). A JSON list such as [{"userId": "KUAAAAAA"}].

customFields.label: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Custom field values to update for the task. A JSON list such as [{"fieldId": "IEAAAAAA", "value": "42"}].

update_task.beforeRequest:
const has=v=>v!=null&&String(v).trim()!=='';const list=v=>{if(!has(v))return[];const a=typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):v;return Array.isArray(a)?a:[a]};const ids=(v,k)=>list(v).map(x=>x&&typeof x==='object'?x[k]:x).filter(has).map(String);const seg=v=>encodeURIComponent(String(v).trim());const day=v=>String(v).split('T')[0];
const b={};if(has(inputs.title))b.title=inputs.title;if(has(inputs.description))b.description=inputs.description;if(has(inputs.status))b.status=inputs.status;if(has(inputs.importance))b.importance=inputs.importance;const r=ids(inputs.assignees,'userId');if(r.length)b.responsibles=r;const d={};if(has(inputs.start_date))d.start=inputs.start_date;if(has(inputs.due_date))d.due=inputs.due_date;if(has(inputs.duration)&&Number(inputs.duration))d.duration=Number(inputs.duration);if(Object.keys(d).length)b.dates=d;const cf=list(inputs.customFields).map(x=>({id:x.fieldId,value:x.value}));if(cf.length)b.customFields=cf;request.url='/tasks/'+seg(inputs.taskId);request.body=b;return request;

create_folder.label: Create Folder
create_folder.description: Create a new folder in Wrike

parentFolderId.label: Parent Folder ID
parentFolderId.description: The ID of the parent folder where the new folder will be created. Leave empty to create at root level.

shareds.label: Shared Users
shareds.description: User IDs to share the folder with. A JSON list such as [{"userId": "KUAAAAAA"}].

project.label: Create as Project
project.description: Whether this folder should be created as a project with additional project settings

projectOwnerId.label: Project Owner ID
projectOwnerId.description: The ID of the user who will own the project (required when creating as project)

projectStartDate.label: Project Start Date
projectStartDate.description: The start date of the project (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

projectEndDate.label: Project End Date
projectEndDate.description: The end date of the project (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

create_folder.beforeRequest:
const has=v=>v!=null&&String(v).trim()!=='';const list=v=>{if(!has(v))return[];const a=typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):v;return Array.isArray(a)?a:[a]};const ids=(v,k)=>list(v).map(x=>x&&typeof x==='object'?x[k]:x).filter(has).map(String);const seg=v=>encodeURIComponent(String(v).trim());const day=v=>String(v).split('T')[0];
const b={title:inputs.title};if(has(inputs.description))b.description=inputs.description;const s=ids(inputs.shareds,'userId');if(s.length)b.shareds=s;if(String(inputs.project)==='true'){const p={};if(!has(inputs.projectOwnerId))throw new Error('Project Owner ID is needed when creating the folder as a project.');p.ownerIds=[inputs.projectOwnerId];if(has(inputs.projectStartDate))p.startDate=day(inputs.projectStartDate);if(has(inputs.projectEndDate))p.endDate=day(inputs.projectEndDate);b.project=p;}request.url=has(inputs.parentFolderId)?'/folders/'+seg(inputs.parentFolderId)+'/folders':'/folders';request.body=b;return request;

create_project.label: Create Project
create_project.description: Create a new project in Wrike

parentFolderId.label: Parent Folder ID
parentFolderId.description: The ID of the parent folder where the project will be created. Leave empty to create at root level.

ownerIds.label: Owner IDs
ownerIds.description: User IDs who will own the project. A JSON list such as [{"userId": "KUAAAAAA"}].

shareds.label: Shared Users
shareds.description: User IDs to share the project with. A JSON list such as [{"userId": "KUAAAAAA"}].

create_project.beforeRequest:
const has=v=>v!=null&&String(v).trim()!=='';const list=v=>{if(!has(v))return[];const a=typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):v;return Array.isArray(a)?a:[a]};const ids=(v,k)=>list(v).map(x=>x&&typeof x==='object'?x[k]:x).filter(has).map(String);const seg=v=>encodeURIComponent(String(v).trim());const day=v=>String(v).split('T')[0];
const b={title:inputs.title,project:{}};const o=ids(inputs.ownerIds,'userId');if(o.length)b.project.ownerIds=o;if(has(inputs.description))b.description=inputs.description;const s=ids(inputs.shareds,'userId');if(s.length)b.shareds=s;if(has(inputs.start_date)||has(inputs.end_date)){b.project.dates={};if(has(inputs.start_date))b.project.dates.start=day(inputs.start_date);if(has(inputs.end_date))b.project.dates.end=day(inputs.end_date);}request.url=has(inputs.parentFolderId)?'/folders/'+seg(inputs.parentFolderId)+'/folders':'/folders';request.body=b;return request;

add_comment.label: Add Comment
add_comment.description: Add a comment or internal note to a task or folder

entityType.label: Entity Type
entityType.description: Select whether you want to add the comment to a task or folder

entityId.label: Entity ID
entityId.description: The ID of the task or folder to add the comment to

text.label: Comment Text
text.description: The text content of the comment

plainText.label: Plain Text
plainText.description: Whether the comment should be treated as plain text (no HTML formatting). Default is HTML formatting.

add_comment.beforeRequest:
const has=v=>v!=null&&String(v).trim()!=='';const list=v=>{if(!has(v))return[];const a=typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):v;return Array.isArray(a)?a:[a]};const ids=(v,k)=>list(v).map(x=>x&&typeof x==='object'?x[k]:x).filter(has).map(String);const seg=v=>encodeURIComponent(String(v).trim());const day=v=>String(v).split('T')[0];
const b={text:inputs.text};if(has(inputs.plainText))b.plainText=String(inputs.plainText)==='true';request.url='/'+seg(inputs.entityType)+'/'+seg(inputs.entityId)+'/comments';request.body=b;return request;

find_task.label: Find Task
find_task.description: Retrieve a task by its ID or lookup fields

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: The ID of the task to retrieve. If provided, other search criteria will be ignored.

title.label: Task Title
title.description: Search for tasks by title (partial match)

folderId.label: Folder ID
folderId.description: Search for tasks within a specific folder

assignees.label: Assignee IDs
assignees.description: Filter tasks by assignee user IDs. A JSON list such as [{"userId": "KUAAAAAA"}].

authors.label: Author IDs
authors.description: Filter tasks by author user IDs. A JSON list such as [{"userId": "KUAAAAAA"}].

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (max 1000)

find_task.beforeRequest:
const has=v=>v!=null&&String(v).trim()!=='';const list=v=>{if(!has(v))return[];const a=typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):v;return Array.isArray(a)?a:[a]};const ids=(v,k)=>list(v).map(x=>x&&typeof x==='object'?x[k]:x).filter(has).map(String);const seg=v=>encodeURIComponent(String(v).trim());const day=v=>String(v).split('T')[0];
if(has(inputs.taskId)){request.url='/tasks/'+seg(inputs.taskId);request.query={};return request;}const q={};for(const k of ['title','folderId','status','importance'])if(has(inputs[k]))q[k]=String(inputs[k]);if(has(inputs.pageSize)&&Number(inputs.pageSize))q.pageSize=String(Number(inputs.pageSize));for(const k of ['sortField','sortOrder'])if(has(inputs[k]))q[k]=String(inputs[k]);const r=ids(inputs.assignees,'userId');if(r.length)q.responsibles=r.join(',');const a=ids(inputs.authors,'userId');if(a.length)q.authors=a.join(',');const form=v=>encodeURIComponent(v).replace(/[!'()~]/g,c=>'%'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()).replace(/%20/g,'+');const qs=Object.entries(q).map(e=>form(e[0])+'='+form(e[1])).join('&');request.url='/tasks'+(qs?'?'+qs:'');request.query={};return request;

find_folder.label: Find Folder / Project
find_folder.description: Retrieve folder / project metadata by ID or name

folderId.label: Folder ID
folderId.description: The ID of the folder/project to retrieve. If provided, other search criteria will be ignored.

title.label: Title
title.description: Search for folders/projects by title (partial match)

parentIds.label: Parent IDs
parentIds.description: Search for folders/projects within specific parent folders. A JSON list such as [{"folderId": "IEAAAAAA"}].

project.label: Is Project
project.description: Filter to only return projects (folders marked as projects)

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: Maximum number of folders/projects to return (max 1000)

authors.label: Author IDs
authors.description: Filter by authors (users who created the folders). A JSON list such as [{"userId": "KUAAAAAA"}].

owners.label: Owner IDs
owners.description: Filter by owners (users who own the projects). A JSON list such as [{"userId": "KUAAAAAA"}].

find_folder.beforeRequest:
const has=v=>v!=null&&String(v).trim()!=='';const list=v=>{if(!has(v))return[];const a=typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):v;return Array.isArray(a)?a:[a]};const ids=(v,k)=>list(v).map(x=>x&&typeof x==='object'?x[k]:x).filter(has).map(String);const seg=v=>encodeURIComponent(String(v).trim());const day=v=>String(v).split('T')[0];
if(has(inputs.folderId)){request.url='/folders/'+seg(inputs.folderId);request.query={};return request;}const q={};if(has(inputs.title))q.title=String(inputs.title);const p=ids(inputs.parentIds,'folderId');if(p.length)q.parentIds=p.join(',');if(has(inputs.project))q.project=String(String(inputs.project)==='true');if(has(inputs.pageSize)&&Number(inputs.pageSize))q.pageSize=String(Number(inputs.pageSize));const a=ids(inputs.authors,'userId');if(a.length)q.authors=a.join(',');const o=ids(inputs.owners,'userId');if(o.length)q.owners=o.join(',');const form=v=>encodeURIComponent(v).replace(/[!'()~]/g,c=>'%'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()).replace(/%20/g,'+');const qs=Object.entries(q).map(e=>form(e[0])+'='+form(e[1])).join('&');request.url='/folders'+(qs?'?'+qs:'');request.query={};return request;

new_task.label: New Task
new_task.description: Fires when a new task is created in Wrike (optionally within a folder).

folderId.label: Folder ID
folderId.description: Optional: Only trigger for tasks created in this specific folder

new_folder.label: New Folder
new_folder.description: Fires when a new folder (or project) is created in Wrike.

parentFolderId.label: Parent Folder ID
parentFolderId.description: Optional: Only trigger for folders created in this specific parent folder

new_subtask_created.label: New Subtask Created
new_subtask_created.description: Triggers when a subtask is created.

parentTaskId.label: Parent Task ID
parentTaskId.description: Optional: Only trigger for subtasks created under this specific parent task
